name: Franchise Architect: Football Community Stats Atlas
refreshPolicy: Server snapshot at most once per 60 seconds; visible clients check at most once per 30 seconds.

metrics.label: Participating browsers
metrics.interpretation: The defensible cohort denominator; it is not a census of all players or humans.

metrics.label: Weeks managed
metrics.interpretation: Receipted franchise weeks completed by the eligible cohort; hidden when fewer than five browsers contribute.

metrics.label: Strategy and tactic mix
metrics.interpretation: Describes declared weekly identities without claiming that a tactic caused an outcome.

metrics.label: Roster market activity
metrics.interpretation: Counts completed trades, signings, contract moves and staff changes once per deduplicated receipt.

metrics.label: Draft philosophy
metrics.interpretation: Shows aggregate position preferences while excluding player names and identifiers.

metrics.label: Pressure and outcomes
metrics.interpretation: Reports observed wins, season boundaries and championships without causal or retention claims.
